scenario.name: Auckland multi-depot field-service planning demo
scenario.desc: A HERE/WGS84 Auckland scenario with 4 real depot addresses, 12 heterogeneous engineers and 44 skill-, qualification-, dependency-, capacity- and time-window-constrained jobs across the North Shore, CBD/west, east and south. Costs are in NZD: elec_price is NZ$0.24/kWh, gas_92_price uses the engine's fixed field name but is calibrated to NZ Regular 91 at NZ$2.94/L, and engineer daily fixed costs use the NZ$29-48/hour trade range plus employer and vehicle overhead.
